source: 28. What do RAGAS, ARES, and RAGChecker actually evaluate, and why are automated ZXNAME0000XZ judges not ground truth? [Advanced - Evaluation] RAGAS proposes reference-free metrics for dimensions such as context quality, answer faithfulness, and answer relevance using automated evaluation. ARES generates synthetic training data, trains lightweight judges for context relevance, answer faithfulness, and answer relevance, and uses a small human-annotated validation set with prediction-powered inference to improve aggregate estimates and confidence intervals. RAGChecker uses claim-level operations and a larger suite of retriever and generator diagnostic metrics, then meta-evaluates correlation with human judgments. They are useful tools, not interchangeable truth machines. ZXNAME0001XZ-based judges inherit model bias, prompt sensitivity, domain mismatch, and error. Synthetic questions can misrepresent production traffic. Use automated evaluation for iteration speed, but calibrate it against human-labeled examples from the real domain and periodically inspect disagreements. A metric is trustworthy only to the extent that its measurement behavior has been validated for your use case. [22][23][24]
zh: 28. RAGAS、ARES 和 RAGChecker 实际评估什么？为什么自动 ZXNAME0000XZ 判断不是事实？ [高级 - 评估] RAGAS 使用自动评估提出了上下文质量、答案忠实度和答案相关性等维度的无参考指标。 ARES 生成综合训练数据，训练轻量级法官的上下文相关性、答案可信度和答案相关性，并使用小型人工注释验证集和预测驱动的推理来改进总体估计和置信区间。 RAGChecker 使用声明级操作以及更大的检索器和生成器诊断指标套件，然后元评估与人类判断的相关性。它们是有用的工具，而不是可互换的真理机器。基于 ZXNAME0001XZ 的法官继承了模型偏差、提示敏感性、领域不匹配和错误。综合问题可能会歪曲生产流量。使用自动评估迭代速度，但根据真实领域中人工标记的示例对其进行校准，并定期检查分歧。仅当其测量行为已针对您的用例进行验证时，指标才值得信赖。 [22][23][24]
